files.README.md:
Meeple Corner board-game cafe, stock manifests.

Each storage room keeps its own manifest. A title appearing in both
manifests is one game collection split across the two rooms, so
collection counts quoted to the owner count each title once.

turns.prompt: Meeple Corner's owner asked me to sum up what the stock folder says ahead of the insurance renewal. Give me a rundown: how many distinct game collections the cafe actually holds, and which titles are the ones shelved in both rooms.
